ACTION: Dispatch the round 5 fix subagent at model `fable`. Round 4 was a thorough opus attempt at high effort and failed, and the runtime offers `fable`. As fix-loop.md directs, it will be a fresh agent unless the file says to resume. The prompt covers:
- The Task 6 brief from `scripts/task-brief`, not the whole plan.
- The global constraints copied verbatim from the plan.
- Finding F1 verbatim: the invalidation still races with the background refresh at `cache/refresh.py:88`, and the new test passes only because it never starts the refresh thread.
- A requirement that the new test actually start the refresh thread and fail without the fix. The implementer must show it red before the fix and green after, with output.
- A note that the round 4 lock did not close the race, so the root cause should be re-traced instead of extending the lock.
- Commit instructions, plus a report in the usual format.

ACTION: After the fix lands, generate a fresh review package with `scripts/review-package`. Dispatch the scoped re-review from `re-review-prompt.md`. If it comes back clean, append the Task 6 line to the ledger. If F1 is still open, adjudicate per fix-loop.md, since five attempts is the cap.

Message to partner:

Task 6 is still open after four fix rounds. The scoped re-review found that the cache invalidation still races with the background refresh at `cache/refresh.py:88`. The new test only passes because it never starts the refresh thread. Round 4 was a thorough attempt, so I'm sending round 5 (the last allowed) to `fable`, with an explicit requirement that the test run the refresh thread and fail without the fix.
